assumptions.acceptance: same fixed selection / IID source proposal; CP pilot envelope not future achieved-precision guarantee
assumptions.weighted_rate: unbiased raw source trial contributions, finite variance and stable higher moments; N0*pilot variance extrapolation; rare support can invalidate it
assumptions.histogram: separate raw bin rate and fraction/bin; normalized delta includes covariance already verified in Phase9; singleton/zero-variance empirical shape plans left undefined
assumptions.proposal_uncertainty: Historical proposal acceptance and weight moments do not transport to different matching/PDF/cuts; independent pilot and explicit densities required
assumptions.physical_normalization: UNKNOWN/BLOCKED; never folded into source MC precision
assumptions.resampling: No bootstrap/resample is counted as a new independent hard event
assumptions.kappa: 2.5 and5 share old1000 sources; new independent-generation or known-density multiple proposals require separate authorization and full cross-kappa bookkeeping

B02_difference_explanation: Bernoulli plugin p(1-p) vs finite-pilot Bessel variance N0/(N0-1); both conditional estimates, neither guaranteed.
